name: DNV Cyber
delivery_note: Delivery model recorded from the company's own description of how it staffs the work.
specialty: DNV Cyber, which absorbed the Nixu consultancy: IT and OT cyber security services, risk and regulatory work for industry, maritime, energy and defence.
notes: Reported to the list as DNV Cyber AS, and there is no such entity: the cyber business sits in DNV AS (org.nr 945748931, Høvik), which is Norwegian-headquartered, while the brand DNV Cyber was formed when DNV absorbed the Finnish consultancy Nixu. The Nixu Norway AS entity from the 2023 edition no longer resolves in the registry, so DNV AS is the entity pinned here.

sources.note: 2025 edition of the list this directory is based on
Publishes IT and OT cyber security services, risk identification and prioritisation, and regulatory guidance
DNV Cyber as the group's cyber security business, including national security and defence, and maritime cyber security
